cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've split the dinner bill exactly. I'll settle the tie with one more round: loser pays the tip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why should anyone lose? We both paid fairly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fairly gives us a tie. I'll accept a result that separates us; give me a criterion we can score.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We both enjoyed it. Isn't that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then rate your enjoyment from one to ten on a napkin. Fold it; we'll reveal together. The lower number pays the tip. I'll count even happiness properly before we leave.

reason: Use B shared enjoyment as the concrete scored tiebreak, defining simultaneous hidden ratings and tip penalty under A authority rather than an unexplained apology for an unspecified offense.
